summary: Hunter fell off his horse on the East Snowmass Creek Trail, sustaining a head injury. Air assets could not respond due to weather; 17 MRA members reached the patient at ~1:36 AM on 9/8 and carried him by litter to the trailhead, arriving ~6:00 AM; he was transported to Valley View Hospital.
location: East Snowmass Creek Trail, ~5 mi up the trail, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness Area
